auditor_source:
from pathlib import Path
from fractions import Fraction as F
import json,struct,hashlib,math
base=Path(r"D:\PROJECTS\.cognition\neuro3d\execution-20261006\point04\inputs01")
sh=lambda b:hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
raw=(base/"input_manifest.json").read_bytes()
assert sh(raw)=="81daaf472db2e021fc6686976ab18dd75eac52cd65565a0d011689f215bc5dc1"
job=json.loads(raw); prep=json.loads((base/"prepare_report.json").read_bytes())
reports=[]
roles={"origin":1,"raw_direction":2,"direction_bound":3,"field":4,"vertex":5,"mode_origin":8,"mode_direction":9,"wavelength":10}
kinds={"bs":0,"mirror":1,"det":2,"escape":3}
d32=lambda w:F.from_float(struct.unpack("<f",struct.pack("<I",w))[0])
for case,evidence in zip(job["cases"],prep["cases"]):
    packet_raw=Path(case["packet_path"]).read_bytes(); assert sh(packet_raw)==case["packet_sha256"]
    assert sh(Path(case["blend_path"]).read_bytes())==case["blend_sha256"]
    packet=json.loads(packet_raw); m=packet["manifest"]; s=m["snapshot"]; bounds=m["direction_bounds"] or {}
    wire=bytes.fromhex(packet["wire_hex"]); w=list(struct.unpack("<%dI"%(len(wire)//4),wire))
    assert wire==Path(evidence["wire_path"]).read_bytes()
    assert sh(wire)==m["wire_sha256"]==evidence["wire_sha256"]
    assert s==json.loads(Path(evidence["snapshot_path"]).read_bytes())
    assert sh(Path(evidence["snapshot_path"]).read_bytes())==evidence["snapshot_sha256"]
    expected=[]; sr=[]; vr=[]; tr=[]; obj_names=sorted(s["objects"])
    for si,source in enumerate(s["sources"]):
        first=len(expected); intervals=bounds.get(source["id"],[[v,v] for v in source["direction"]])
        for role,values,endpoint in (("origin",source["position_BU"],0),("raw_direction",source["direction"],0),
            ("direction_bound",[v[0] for v in intervals],0),("direction_bound",[v[1] for v in intervals],1),
            ("field",source["field_reim"],0)):
            for axis,value in enumerate(values): expected.append((role,si,0,axis,endpoint,float(value)))
        sr.append([si,0xffffffff]+list(range(first,first+14))+[0]*16)
    for oi,name in enumerate(obj_names):
        obj=s["objects"][name]; start_vertex=len(vr)
        for vi,position in enumerate(obj["vertices_world_BU"]):
            indices=[]
            for axis,value in enumerate(position):
                indices.append(len(expected)); expected.append(("vertex",oi,vi,axis,0,float(value)))
            vr.append([len(vr),oi,vi]+indices+[0,0])
        for fi,face in enumerate(obj["faces"]):
            assert len(face)==3 and len(set(face))==3
            tr.append([len(tr),oi,fi]+[start_vertex+i for i in face]+[kinds[obj["kind"]],0])
        if obj["kind"] in ("det","escape"):
            for key,role in (("mode_origin_BU","mode_origin"),("mode_direction","mode_direction")):
                for axis,value in enumerate(obj[key]): expected.append((role,oi,0,axis,0,float(value)))
        mm=m["material_binary64_metadata"][oi]; assert mm["object_id"]==name
        for key,value in obj.items():
            if key in ("phase_rad","power_transmittance"):
                assert mm["parameters"][key]["binary64_words"]==list(struct.unpack("<II",struct.pack("<d",float(value))))
                assert mm["parameters"][key]["numeric_ABI"] is False
    expected.append(("wavelength",0xffffffff,0,0,0,float(s["lambda_BU"])))
    assert len(expected)==w[4]==len(m["scalars"])
    assert sr==m["source_records"] and vr==m["vertex_records"] and tr==m["triangle_records"]
    lows=0
    for i,(role,owner,element,component,endpoint,value) in enumerate(expected):
        record=w[32+i*8:40+i*8]
        assert record[2:]==[roles[role],owner,element,component,endpoint,0]
        assert math.isfinite(value) and d32(record[0])+d32(record[1])==F.from_float(value)
        assert m["scalars"][i]["observed_binary64_words"]==list(struct.unpack("<II",struct.pack("<d",value)))
        assert F(*m["scalars"][i]["exact_input"])==F.from_float(value)
        assert m["scalars"][i]["residual_exact"]==[0,1]
        lows+=(record[1]&0x7fffffff)!=0
    so=32+len(expected)*8; vo=so+len(sr)*32; to=vo+len(vr)*8; total=to+len(tr)*8
    header=[0x4e33484c,1,32,total,len(expected),32,8,len(sr),so,32,len(vr),vo,8,len(tr),to,8,len(obj_names),len(expected)-1,0]+[0]*13
    assert w[:32]==header
    expected_words=header+w[32:32+len(expected)*8]+sum(sr,[])+sum(vr,[])+sum(tr,[])
    assert w==expected_words
    assert m["source_order"]==[x["id"] for x in s["sources"]] and m["object_order"]==obj_names
    assert len(sr)==w[7] and len(vr)==w[10] and len(tr)==w[13]
    rows=len(sr)*len(vr)+len(sr)+2*len(tr)
    reports.append(dict(case=case["case_id"],objects=len(obj_names),sources=len(sr),vertices=len(vr),triangles=len(tr),scalars=len(expected),nonzero_lows=lows,wire_bytes=len(wire),rows_per_mode=rows,components_per_mode=3*rows))
assert prep["native_gpu_executed"] is False
print(json.dumps(dict(status="PASS_CPU_INDEPENDENT_SAVED_PACKET_AUDIT",cases=reports,native_executed=False,codec_or_producer_imports=0),sort_keys=True))
